title: Mentee sign-up form
description:
In this form, we aim to collect information about mentees (i.e., those seeking help in one of the categories below) as part of FORRT's "Support for underprivileged and underrepresented ERCs" as well as FORRT's " Remote Mentorship program."

Please note you will only be contacted in case there is a possible match, which you can accept or not.
confirmation: Thank you for submitting your response. We have received your data and should soon come back to you.

items.title: What's the field of expertise on which you would like to obtain help (e.g., cognitive psychology, behavioral economics, etc.). Be as specific as possible.
What would you like help with?
options: Application materials for transitioning out of academia to industry
Feedback on a manuscript (wherein you are the writer/first author)
Help with specifics of Open and Reproducible Science (e.g., preregistrations, registered reports, multiverse analyses)
Help with written (academic) English and/or copy-editing
External remote mentorship for a Bachelor thesis
External remote mentorship for a Master thesis

items.title: Please write here the specifics of what you need help with. This will be sent to a potential mentor who will evaluate their fit with your request/description. Please be as specific as you can.
Would you say you are:
options: student/ERC from underprivileged and underrepresented background
non-WEIRD background (Western, educated, and from industrialized, rich, and democratic countries)
studying/working in a institution without local "Open and Reproducible Science" friendly personnel

items.title: Please leave any comments or remarks or questions (for example suggestions for this form or other additional info you would like to share)
